# Circumscribe

Qualified name: `manim.animation.indication.Circumscribe`

class Circumscribe(*mobject=None*, *\*args*, *use\_override=True*, *\*\*kwargs*)
:   Bases: [`Succession`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.animation.composition.Succession.html#manim.animation.composition.Succession "manim.animation.composition.Succession")

    Draw a temporary line surrounding the mobject.

    Parameters:
    :   - **mobject** ([*Mobject*](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.html#manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject "manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject")) – The mobject to be circumscribed.
        - **shape** (*type**[*[*Rectangle*](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.geometry.polygram.Rectangle.html#manim.mobject.geometry.polygram.Rectangle "manim.mobject.geometry.polygram.Rectangle")*]* *|* *type**[*[*Circle*](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.geometry.arc.Circle.html#manim.mobject.geometry.arc.Circle "manim.mobject.geometry.arc.Circle")*]*) – The shape with which to surround the given mobject. Should be either
          [`Rectangle`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.geometry.polygram.Rectangle.html#manim.mobject.geometry.polygram.Rectangle "manim.mobject.geometry.polygram.Rectangle") or [`Circle`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.geometry.arc.Circle.html#manim.mobject.geometry.arc.Circle "manim.mobject.geometry.arc.Circle")
        - **fade\_in** (*bool*) – Whether to make the surrounding shape to fade in. It will be drawn otherwise.
        - **fade\_out** (*bool*) – Whether to make the surrounding shape to fade out. It will be undrawn otherwise.
        - **time\_width** (*float*) – The time\_width of the drawing and undrawing. Gets ignored if either fade\_in or fade\_out is True.
        - **buff** (*float*) – The distance between the surrounding shape and the given mobject.

        - **run\_time** (*float*) – The duration of the entire animation.
        - **kwargs** (*Any*) – Additional arguments to be passed to the [`Succession`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.animation.composition.Succession.html#manim.animation.composition.Succession "manim.animation.composition.Succession") constructor

    Examples

    Example: UsingCircumscribe

    [Video example](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/UsingCircumscribe-1.mp4)

    ```
    from manim import *

    class UsingCircumscribe(Scene):
        def construct(self):
            lbl = Tex(r"Circum-\\scribe").scale(2)
            self.add(lbl)
            self.play(Circumscribe(lbl))
            self.play(Circumscribe(lbl, Circle))
            self.play(Circumscribe(lbl, fade_out=True))
            self.play(Circumscribe(lbl, time_width=2))
            self.play(Circumscribe(lbl, Circle, True))
    ```
